title: Your first build
description:
This program is already complete. Press **Run** to compile it and see its output, then press **Check**.

Nothing to change yet: the point is to see the whole trip from text to running program.

1. **Run** compiles the code and starts the program in the console below.
2. **Check** compiles it again and compares what it prints with what the task expects.
hints: Just press Check. If it fails, press the circular arrow above the editor to restore the original code.
